audit_mode: Read-only inspection except this JSON output. No model imports, processes stopped, deletions, browser, installs or downloads.

shared_dependency_policy.expected_usage: Existing pinned environment/model reused without installation or download. New caches/adapters/runs remain in v2.
shared_dependency_policy.note: The shared targets are owned by the current UID and writable. Read-only is the execution policy and pinned/hash-checked usage, not filesystem permission isolation. No permissions changed by this audit.
shared_dependency_policy.v2_cleanup: shutil.rmtree(v2) removes its .venv/model symlinks without traversing their parent targets. Parent environment/model remain intact.
shared_dependency_policy.parent_cleanup: shutil.rmtree(parent) ultimately deletes the real parent dependencies and every nested v2 artifact. Export for retention must be outside the parent root, not merely outside v2.

managed_environment: manage.py points HF_HOME/HF_HUB_CACHE/HF_XET_CACHE/HF_ASSETS_CACHE/PIP_CACHE_DIR/XDG_CACHE_HOME/PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX/TMPDIR and HF_TOKEN_PATH inside v2. No --online flag in fixed pipeline stage launches; HF and Transformers remain offline. Virtualenv/model are borrowed reads, new process registries are separate.

orchestration.children_launch: Each fixed stage calls v2 manage.py exec, then caffeinate -i, then resource_guard, then one model command. Each stage has a separate session/process group and v2 job record.
orchestration.failure_policy: Any nonzero managed-stage return stops the one-shot pipeline; resource guard returns nonzero for limit/measurement failure.
orchestration.exam_generation_policy: Both training calls return successfully before eval loop starts. Frozen-input hashes are asserted before each stage; no test scores steer training in this orchestrator.
orchestration.unmanaged_controller_note: Direct Python orchestrator has cwd=v2, can generate only local __pycache__, and must finish or be separately identified before cleanup. Nested manage cleanup cannot automatically stop an unregistered controller; lsof should detect its cwd and refuse removal.

resource_controls.guarded_processes: Each model-command child and observed verified descendants. Guard/caffeinate/manage/orchestrator themselves are not included in the model footprint sum; host pressure and swap monitor the whole machine.
resource_controls.pressure_stop: Host pressure >=2 for three consecutive samples
resource_controls.pid_reuse_protection: libproc ri_proc_start_abstime identity verified before descendant signals; own direct Popen child may be terminated safely before reaping.

cleanup_sequence: Finish both training trajectories and every fixed exam, perform semantic review, and finalize report before cleanup.
Export all intended retained results/protocols/locks/data/labels/measurement logs/video HTML outside the PARENT root, verify SHA256/readback; retain adapters only if desired explicitly.
Wait for direct run_fixed_pipeline.py to exit. Confirm both parent and v2 status registries; no training/evaluation jobs should be running.

For v2-only cleanup: run its manage.py cleanup dry-run, then its cleanup --apply --expect-id 94c02954-6d12-48fc-a9bb-b854790ea84c from outside v2. This removes v2 cache/output/symlinks only; preserve report first.

For final whole-experiment cleanup: after v2 jobs/controller finish, use parent manage.py cleanup dry-run then cleanup --apply --expect-id 10cc942d-fd1d-4042-b33b-404efa0196f9 from outside parent. Parent stop_owned handles only parent registry, including report-server; its lsof +D parent audit must succeed after that. A live v2 controller/child/open report file should cause refusal, not forced unrelated process termination.
If parent cleanup refuses, inspect exact reported PIDs and wait/close only experiment-owned holders; never broad killall or stop KS KB, Docker, browser, Ollama or unrelated apps.

Verify deleted root(s), absence of experiment processes, readable retained report and actual free-disk delta. Shared dependencies count once; do not claim model symlinks contain a second copy or that logical bytes equal physical reclaimed SSD space.
